text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out and about with
Mejiro
Ryan...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She stops and stares at a claw machine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: You want one of those plushies?

text_block_list.text:
Well... It reminds me of a scene from this
book I
read.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
There's a girl who's trying to get a
plushie, but
she's not having any
success...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Then her boyfriend shows up, gets the
plushie
easily, and gives it to her!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted something like that
to happen
to me!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
...Geez, wh-what am I talking about?
Please
forget I said anything, haha!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Um... If you'd get one for me, any of
them would
be fine.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
